maps.name: Abandoned Temple
maps.about: You can't return from where you come if you enter this place. You have to go through the whole temple and the female orcs within before reaching the exit.

maps.name: Aluwen Temple
maps.about: In Aluwen Temple you will find Noria, the High priest of Aluwen, the Goddess of Defense. There are two entrances to this temple, one in Desert Pines the other in White Stone.

maps.name: Battle Hall
maps.about: In this place you will find Ilie, the manager of Instances. In the past, Battle Hall was used as a way to enter several PK maps, with exits to Kilaran Field, Tahraji Desert and Ruins of Tirnym, this last map is not PK anymore. There was also a PK area inside the Battle Hall but now its gone. The exit to Tahraji Desert was also removed.

maps.name: Carmien Manor
maps.about: Carmien Manor consists of an entrance room with dining room and NPC. To access lower levels you use a non-hidden trap door. This leads to a serpentine set of hallways with cells, spiked pits and other jail features inhabited by trolls. This is connected to an underground cavern with armed orcs, large spiders, fluffy rabbits, and a sloping hallway with interesting stalagmites worth examining. The latter two creatures make it very popular with Fluffy Rabbit trainers for they can mana drain the spiders to heal themselves. The exit leads to an anteroom useful for healing before exiting outside. It exits to a locked door in Carmien Village, close to Nordcarn.

maps.name: Coal Cave
maps.about: As the name suggests, this place is one of the better places for the young traveller to acquire this useful mineral. <!--

maps.about: This delightful cavern has much to offer the young explorer. Ample supplies of various ores and minerals makes this a logical first cave for our new explorers. The creatures here are non-aggresssive, and may even be a source of thread and gems for those brave enough.

maps.name: Desert Pines
maps.about: Desert Pines has luxurious heat and nearly no humidity in the south. The Evergreen Woods on the northern side of this territory are inhabited by normal forest creatures: a Bear, Deers, Foxes, Racoons, Wolves, Brown Rabbits and snakes of Green, Red and Brown variety as well as some fantasy creatures like Wood Sprites and Brownies. To the south, walled by mountains which are littered with caves, exists the Kamara Desert. Cactus and Quartz are exposed in the heat, but watch out for the snakes that prefer this climate. Outside the storage in Kamara Desert are a large caravan and many trade bots. This is the second largest trade area in EL. Many fighters test their strength in the PK arenas. Others just harvest in Crystal Caverns or the Coal Cave or visit the alchemy school in the Desert Tropics in the southwest.

maps.name: Isla Prima
maps.about: When you first awaken in the Eternal Lands, you find yourself on Isla Prima. Beginners often start by talking to the Tutorial NPC; he will try to show you around the Eternal Lands. There are various animals on Isla Prima but no monsters. It is also home of the Wraith, where you can get attributes, nexuses and perks. One of the most useful features of Isla Prima is the Beam. From every non-PK map, you can instantly teleport back to the Beam on Isla Prima by using the #beam me command. Time to storage (advanced players): 1:20 "#beam me" to VotD storage

maps.name: Naralik
maps.about: Naralik is a swamp filled with goblins, spiders and snakes. It is full of ancient statues telling the tale of a long lost civilization. It still has a lot of flowers to harvest from the old gardens. Mages often train magic by draining the mana from the large spiders and unleashing it in different ways. The flowers and the mining resources in the catacombs make many high level mixers call it their home.

maps.name: Naralik Catacombs
maps.about: These old catacombs are filled with skeletons, spiders and a clan of armed and unarmed orcs, making this a dangerous place for new players. However, the rich resources of iron ore, emeralds and titanium ore bring many experienced players to harvest. But beware!! Mortos always keeps half an eye focused on Naralik Catacombs for a specific reason - and his followers visit it with high frequency.

maps.name: Nordcarn
maps.about: A busy city with city walls and a many connections to often visited sites makes this a map full of life. The city wall is an often used ranging point for aspiring rangers and the plentiful wild life lure young adventurers out to hunt rabbits, deer and wolves. One can also meet harvesters dragging their large packs from the White stone diamond and coal caves. Nordcarn has a huge collection of tradebots. Close to VOTD and just south of the city walls near the Storage Barn, the ground is full of tradebots doing business with wanton adventurers. There is no Ring of Nordcarn, no matter how often you ask a crafter. The portal will drop you at [100,132], north-west of the inner city mountains but within the city walls.

Except for the port, titanium mining is the biggest industry in the city, titanium is a very lightweight and strong metal used extensively in armor and weapons. There are only 2 dangers in Portland, a lone Goblin called "Bob the Gob" and the GIWS Invasions that occasionally start in the Titanium Mines.

maps.name: Ruins of Tirnym
maps.about: Ruins of Tirnym is one of the least frequently visited maps in Seridia. It is the realm of the most deadly monsters, the Chimerans. In a small ravine in the north you can find remains of a caravan. Other notable places are a small graveyard and some ruined buildings, as well as the mysterious magic school.

maps.name: Seridia Docks
maps.about: Seridia Docks, the last step on the way to Irilion (C2), Sarma can sell you a ticket to C2 for 100 gold coins, but the price may be higher if you're antisocial. The entrance to the docks is hidden.

maps.name: Seridia Portal Room
maps.about: This map is only accessible by a spell or a secret. It allows quick travel to all main outdoor maps of Seridia by walking into the appropriate portal, each marked by a flag and a message when approaching the portal. Irilion has its own Portal Room.

maps.name: Seridia Underworld
maps.about: This is the Underworld of Seridia (C1). You are teleported to this map if you die for whatever reasons in any map of Seridia. To reach the exit of this underworld, a player only need walk to the middle-north of the map. Exiting this underworld takes the player to approximately the #beam me up spot of IP. #Beam me up and other teleport actions are blocked in the underworld. For additional information about Underworlds check the Underworld page. <!--

maps.name: South Cave
maps.about: This cave, commonly known as "ruby cave", contains gargoyles, and all kinds of skeletons and goblins. This cave is a good source for amber, bones, iron ore and rubies. It used to have a thriving society, but is now mostly ruins, inhabited by monsters. Small creeks constrain movement, so bringing essences for the Teleport to Range Spell is extremely helpful.

maps.name: Tahraji Desert
maps.about: The Ruins of Matajin are in the north, and Mortos Valley is in the south along with Tahraji Dragon Cave. There is an oasis near the middle of the map and a [[Summoning#Summoning Arenas|summoning arena]] offshore in the Ghealan Ocean. There is also a tent safe to rest in Mortos Valley. WARNING! This map is PK! You cannot use #beam me in this map - it is not true from ALL PK Maps. Rostogol Stones do not work here, either. However, it is a LEGACY map from back in the days when things did not require a cooldown period, so everything has a cooldown of 1. This is a major advantage, if you can find a secluded space to mix.

maps.name: Valley of the Dwarves
maps.about: Valley of the Dwarves, also known as VOTD (see Acronyms), is a very popular place to access storage even though you can't manufacture close to storage. It is close to the Kilaran Field (KF) PK fighting grounds and has many low level monsters so you often find lots of people close to storage. VOTD storage is the fastest one can reach from Isla Prima so wins from events are paid here and people often trade and offer goods in local chat. For many, VOTD is home. It is so popular that trade bots are not allowed here - instead one has to go south to Nordcarn, east to Tarsengaard or take the boat to Desert Pines to find tradebots. One of the popular places is the flower shop where young adventurers sell lilacs they have picked to earn gold. * Entering from the Portals Room drops you in the settlement at [76,138] just outside of the General Store.

maps.name: White Stone

Other settlements found in this area are Tirnwood Vale in the central part, Lakeside Village in the southeast, and Grahm's Village in the southwest. In the east, you can find the frightening Vermor Castle.

maps.name: Arius
maps.about: Arius is a beautiful island in the southeast corner of Irilion, connected by boat to Irsis and Irinveron and by airship to Willowvine Forest. Arius is very green with abundant plant life, good for harvesting almost every kind of flower. It is the best place to make RVM. Arius City occupies the northwest corner of the island. Arius Magic School is in the north part of the city. Just north and outside of the main city is storage. To the east of the city are the Limestone mountains, connected to the magic school by tunnels and to the countryside by a cave. In the mountains, you find gypsum and turquoise mines. The labyrinth of tunnels and passageways in the mountains can be confusing, but with some exploring, you can learn your way around. * Portal room exit point is in the Magic School Garden at [89,299].

maps.name: Idaloran
maps.about: Idaloran is probably the most important map in Irilion (C2), as it connects with 9 other maps and has many things to offer in terms of resources and commerce. Idaloran is very large and there are teleportals available to help you when walking: Teleportals * Teleport SW [134,86] (to NE) * Teleport NE [616,444] (to SW) * Teleport SE [597,41] (to NW) * Teleport NW [285,521] (to SE) Idaloran City occupies a large part of the map, in the center. The city is surrounded by stone walls and entrances are under archways. There are paths along the top of some of the city walls. Three waterways converge in the city. Other major geographical areas of Idaloran include Seedan Island (North Central), Nymorq Wood (Far North), North Crimshin Forest (Northwest), Jahir Beach (Far Northwest), Idaloran Cemetery (Central West), Crimshin Port (Far West), Southern Crimshin Forest (Far Southwest and South), South

maps.name: Irilion Portal Room
maps.about: This map is only accessible by a spell or a secret. It allows quick travel to all main outdoor maps of Irilion by walking into the appropriate portal, each marked by a flag and a message when approaching the portal. Seridia has its own Portal Room.

maps.name: Irilion Underworld
maps.about: This is the Underworld of Irilion (C2). You are teleported to this map if you die for whatever reasons in any map of Irilion. Reaching the exit of this underworld is more complex than Seridia's underworld, where the player may have to use some map objects in order to escape. Additionally, while the exit is located middle-south, the player cannot walk directly south to reach it. Exiting this underworld takes the player to Idaloran cemetery not far from the boats. #Beam me up and other teleport actions are blocked in the underworld. For additional information about Underworlds check the Underworld page. <!--

maps.name: Iscalrith
maps.about: While at first glance this seems a lovely and peaceful land, the cold awaits the unwary and strange beasts wander the forests. For those who enjoy mazes, the cave system presents a few unique challenges. Using the Teleport to Range Spell is a useful and reliable shortcut for these caves, plus is good magic training as well. Note: This land does cause light cold damage so you may need to adjust your armor or wear a different cloak to not take damage. Note 2: Throughout the game trade bots, NPCs, books and rings refer to this map as 'Iscarlith'.

maps.name: Palon Vertas
maps.about: Palon Vertas is one of the five provinces of the Idal Empire, the fourth one in order of rank, and is ruled by a prefect. While not as important as Idaloran, Palon Vertas holds a central place in Irilion's geography in virtue of its position, and thanks to the abundance of resources it offers. In the mines you can collect coal, sulfur, gold ore, emeralds, cinnabar and amber (as well as obsidian in some future moment). The city of Salingen, in the middle of Palon Vertas, is known for the many flowers growing there. You can also take advantage of a storage facility, a flower shop and a general store. In the southeast corner you'll find the village of Treesoar and a tavern, while in the northwest corner there's the famous magic school. maps.name: Thelinor
maps.about: Beware Thelinor, the map where giants, fluffies, and PK'ers abound. The majority of the map is PK, except within the city limits. Safe entry from Melinis is possible, and access to the outside storage NPC is safely possible from that direction. The tavern within the city, however, is PK.

maps.name: Trassian
maps.about: Trassian is really two maps: * Trassian, a L-shaped map which consists of a number of buildings and igloos (2 large and 2 small). It is mostly unoccupied except for the Tavern. It contains 2 working fire pits with wood logs next to it. This is very useful for the snow leopards and polar bears will provide much meat to cook. It has a Blue Quartz mine and several secret mines. * Dra Syn, a closed Draegoni city, accessible only via Wizard Passage (this requires a quest) or several secret, back doors known only to Draegoni. Dra Syn is built both above and below ground requiring a convoluted path to get anywhere. The ability to perform Teleport to Range Spell will help in some cases to shorten your trip. Deepstone Caverns is one part of Dra Syn, Saret's Cave is another part.
